name: bit-rate-maximizer
description: A browser game scoring the player's information rate in bits/second: click the orange square on a 32x32 grid as quickly and accurately as you can for 60 seconds. The original falling-lanes keyboard version is kept as v1.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:v1
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
